Title: [LSJ] question on clan impersonation and derange

Messages.Author: pallando
Messages.Body:
as far as i know this topic has been discussed before but i couldn't find
the answer to my question.

what happens when a deranged gideon fontaine (now !malkavian) impersonates
into another clan? i'd say he stays !malkavian until he moves the deramge
somewhere else.

thanks

pallando

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


He's got two effects on him that temporarily change his clan.
The Derange changes his clan to !Malk until he moves it.
The Clan Impersonation changes his clan until he burns it.

With neither one having any claim to the right to override the other,
the last one played (the one "on top") has precedence.
